description: Get full details for a Trackly job ID returned by search or your saved queue. Missing or closed postings return availability=unavailable with retryable=false and a next step; do not retry that ID. Failures include a category and retry guidance.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

id.description: Positive numeric Trackly job ID from trackly_search_jobs or your saved queue, not an employer requisition ID or URL. Correct invalid arguments before retrying.

name: trackly_get_job
